app.title: BridgeLab
app.subtitle: HL7 made simple
diff.title: Compare messages
diff.sameTab: Both sides show the same tab — pick two different tabs to compare.
diff.needTwoTabs: Open at least two tabs to compare messages.
xsd.title: Export HL7 message schema as XSD
xsd.intro: Pick an HL7 version and a message type. BridgeLab generates a self-contained XSD you can save or copy for use in your integration pipelines.
xsd.upgradeRequired: This message requires a {tier} license. The free tier covers ADT^A01, ADT^A40, ORM^O01 and ORU^R01 in v2.5. Upgrade via Help → Activation or contact info@techemv.it.
tree.empty: Open an HL7 file or paste a message to begin.
inspector.title: Field Inspector
inspector.noSelection: Select a node in the tree to inspect
inspector.name: Name
inspector.schemaUnknown: Not in HL7 standard (Z-segment or custom)
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Drop JSON rule packs in the plugins folder. Validation rules extend the built-in HL7 checks; anonymization rules extend the PHI catalogue. No code execution - plugins are pure data.
plugins.noPlugins: No plugins installed. Use the "Open plugins folder" button and create a .json file under validation/ or anonymization/.
plugins.gated: Inactive — the Community tier allows up to 3 active plugins.
dialog.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Do you want to save before closing?
update.title: Software update
update.available: Version {version} is available (you have {current}). Download it now?
update.restartManually: Update installed — please restart BridgeLab manually to apply it.
update.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Please try again later or visit the releases page.
val.parseFailedHint: The message starts with '{prefix}' but HL7 messages must start with 'MSH|'. Fix the header and try again.
val.notMshStart: First segment must be MSH, found '{found}'
comm.ackNoControlId: No Message Control ID (MSH-10) found in the current message — an ACK cannot be correlated.
batch.title: Batch validation
batch.intro: Pick files or a folder: every message is parsed and validated, one row per file.
batch.noFiles: No message files found in the selection.
batch.openHint: Click to open in the editor
banon.title: Batch anonymization
banon.intro: Pick source files or a folder and an output folder: every message is anonymized (built-in PHI catalogue + active plugin rules) and written as a copy — originals are never touched.
bundle.graphTooBig: Graph view is available up to {max} entries — use the list for larger bundles.
gen.title: Generate test messages
gen.intro: Creates syntactically valid messages with plausible synthetic patient data (no real PHI). Use a seed for reproducible sets.
inspector.valueNotInTable: Current value is not in the HL7 table for this field.
tc.checkUnexpectedlyValid: Expected invalid, but the message validates without errors
status.notParsed: Not parsed — press F6 to validate
status.truncatedHint: Click to expand all truncated fields
status.validationHint: Validation result — click to open the panel
welcome.title: Welcome to BridgeLab
welcome.subtitle: Open, inspect, validate and send HL7 v2 and FHIR messages.
welcome.pasteHint: …or just paste an HL7 message anywhere (Ctrl+V).
welcome.card.generatorDesc: Valid ADT/ORU/ORM messages with synthetic data — instant fixtures, no PHI.
welcome.card.anonymizeDesc: Mask PHI in one message or a whole folder — originals never touched.
welcome.card.listenerDesc: Receive live traffic with a console, auto-ACK and per-message inspection.
welcome.card.xsdDesc: Schemas for 7 HL7 versions — 4 common v2.5 messages free, the full catalogue (1,964 structures) with Pro.
tc.emptyHint: Use “Save Current Message” to add the open message as a test case.
